name: Anthropic Claude
description: Connect Meshery to Anthropic's Claude API to generate Kubernetes Designs from natural language prompts. Your API key is stored as a Credential and is never included in generated Designs, logs, or events.

registered.description: Validates the stored API key against Anthropic's API and marks this provider ready for Design generation.
Keeps the connection registered but excludes it from the provider list shown during Design generation.

connected.description: Stops using this provider for Design generation. The connection and credential are kept, so it can be reconnected without re-entering the API key.
Removes this connection and its associated credential from Meshery.

disconnected.description: Re-validates the stored API key and resumes using this provider for Design generation.
Removes this connection and its associated credential from Meshery.

baseUrl.title: API Base URL
baseUrl.description: Base URL for Anthropic's API. Change only if routing through a proxy.

defaultModel.title: Default Model
defaultModel.description: Model used for Design generation requests unless overridden per-request.

name.title: Connection Name
name.description: Optional friendly name for this connection.

apiKey.title: API Key
apiKey.description: Your Anthropic API key. Stored as a Credential, never written to Connection metadata, generated Designs, logs, or events.
